title: A new work takes the stage for the UNI sesquicentennial finale
summary_en: Music, theater and UNI history will share the stage at the Sesquicentennial Arts Showcase on Thursday, Oct. 8, during Homecoming week.
title_cn: A new work takes the stage for the UNI sesquicentennial finale

title: From UNI to Amazon, Evan Seuren leveraged UNI to turn creativity into a career
summary_en: Evan Seuren turned his creative instincts into a career at Amazon Ads. From digital marketing competitions and student leadership at UNI to leading enterprise advertising strategy for brands like T-Mobile, Pokémon and Snapchat, Seuren’s story shows how hands-on experience can open big doors.
title_cn: From UNI to Amazon, Evan Seuren leveraged UNI to turn creativity into a career
